# Android Developers

> Official Android development platform providing tools, libraries, and guidance for building apps across phones, tablets, wearables, cars, TVs, XR devices, and ChromeOS.

Android Developers is Google's comprehensive resource hub for creating Android applications. It covers everything from foundational development concepts and Kotlin programming to specialized domains like gaming, health, media, and emerging platforms like Android XR.

## Key Topics

- Android
- Kotlin
- Jetpack Compose
- Android Studio
- Google Play
- Wear OS
- Android XR
- Material Design
- Jetpack libraries
- Multidevice development
- Health Connect
- Media3 & ExoPlayer
- App distribution
- Adaptive apps
- Kotlin Multiplatform

## Getting Started

- [Android Developers Home](https://developer.android.com): Main hub for Android development tools, platform updates, and resources.
- [Android Essentials](https://developer.android.com/get-started): Entry point for Android app development with essentials and guides.
- [Build Your First App](https://developer.android.com/get-started/overview): Tutorial for building first Android app with Kotlin and Compose.
- [Training Courses](https://developer.android.com/courses): Training courses in Android Basics with Compose and Kotlin.
- [Android Codelabs](https://developer.android.com/get-started/codelabs): Hands-on coding tutorials and guided codelabs for Android development.

## Core Languages & UI

- [Kotlin and Android](https://developer.android.com/kotlin): Comprehensive guide to Kotlin as Android's recommended language.
- [Adopt Compose for Teams](https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/adopt): Guide for team adoption of Jetpack Compose UI toolkit.

## Multidevice Development

- [Adaptive Apps](https://developer.android.com/adaptive-apps): Guide to building responsive apps for phones, tablets, and foldables.
- [Android XR](https://developer.android.com/xr): Android XR platform guide with Jetpack XR SDK and tools.
- [Wear OS](https://developer.android.com/wear): Wear OS development guide for smartwatch and wearable apps.
- [Android for Cars](https://developer.android.com/cars): Android Automotive OS and Auto development for in-vehicle apps.
- [Android TV](https://developer.android.com/tv): Android TV development guide for big-screen apps and games.
- [ChromeOS Devices](https://developer.android.com/chrome-os): Guide for porting and optimizing Android apps for Chromebooks.

## Specialized Development

- [Android Games](https://developer.android.com/games): Game development hub with optimization, tools, and distribution guides.
- [Camera & Media](https://developer.android.com/media): Media3, ExoPlayer, and camera development for multimedia apps.
- [Social & Messaging Apps](https://developer.android.com/social-and-messaging): Development guide for social and messaging apps with media features.
- [Health & Fitness](https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness): Health Connect and wearable health app development guide.
- [Productivity Apps](https://developer.android.com/productivity): Productivity app development for large screens and foldables.

## AI & Machine Learning

- [AI on Android](https://developer.android.com/ai): Guide to integrating AI with Gemini Nano, ML Kit, and GenAI APIs.

## Developer Account & Distribution

- [Android Developer Verification](https://developer.android.com/developer-verification): Instructions for developer identity verification and account setup.
